Definition: from G5048; a completer, i.e. consummater:--finisher.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the finisher, the completer. Jesus is the author and finisher of our faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the finisher of faith is the one who began it, and He does not leave His work half done.
